blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Rank counts only communities with at least ten homes listed. Falling listings with steady sales mean homes are being absorbed faster; rising listings with steady sales mean more choice for buyers. A sellers’ best bet is a community where homes sell quickly against the number listed; a buyers’ best bet is the reverse. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Between June 2026 and September 2026, detached houses: listings fell from 63 in June to 41 in September (−34.9%), and it took 16.0% of the city’s 188 sales over the period; condos and townhomes: listings fell from 11 in June to 8 in September (−27.3%), and it took 3.8% of the city’s 184 sales over the period.

The monthly write-ups singled out Southwest for detached houses in September (a sellers’ best bet); detached houses in June (a buyers’ best bet); condos and townhomes in September (a sellers’ best bet); condos and townhomes in June, July, August (a buyers’ best bet).

blocks.text: Lots and land in Southwest Maple Ridge

items.t: Confirmed form: freehold single-detached housing, with suites and garden suites as accessory uses in RS-1, and higher-density mixed-use forms enabled by the adopted Hammond Area Plan update near the plan area's commercial nodes.

Lot character — RS-1 zone minimums, as stated: the standard house zone is RS-1 (Single Detached Residential) under Zoning Bylaw No. 7600-2019 s. 605 — minimum lot area 668.0 m², minimum lot width 18.0 m, minimum lot depth 27.0 m, maximum lot coverage 40%; accessory uses include Secondary Suite Residential and Detached Garden Suite Residential. These are zone minimums for RS-1, not a claim that every Hammond lot is that size.

Housing pattern the lots carry: Hammond's stock includes older single-detached houses around a historic commercial area, and the wider sub-area is mainly single-family development east of Hammond, under RS-1.
Bare-land strata: none verified

: Val Maria (21163 Lougheed Highway) is a 55+ manufactured home park, ownership recorded as "Leasehold not prepaid-NonStrata" — the buyer owns the home and rents the pad; it is NOT a bare-land lot, NOT strata and NOT fee-simple land. The Maples Housing Co-operative (21570 Cherrington Ave, 31 semi-detached homes) is a co-operative, not a lot sale.

ALR vs non-ALR split: no statement placing Agricultural Land Reserve land inside this urban sub-area was found in the official sources checked; parcel-level ALR status can be checked on the Agricultural Land Commission's mapping. No ALR percentage split is stated or invented.

Serviced vs unserviced: in the Fraser River Escarpment policy area, City policy says septic fields are to be avoided and new residences require sanitary sewers, and all drainage from new construction must connect to the City storm drainage system — the serviced position for new building in that policy area, as the City states it.

Market context, labelled correctly: SnapStats has NO land category (Detached vs "Condos & Townhomes" combined only; Maple Ridge IS a SnapStats-covered community) — no detached figure is presented as a land figure.

Hammond Area Plan update: the Hammond Area Plan (OCP s. 10.5) has been given final reading and adopted by Council, and its OCP amending bylaw update enables mixed-use, higher-density buildings in the plan area and incorporates the additional density required by provincial legislation. This is plan enablement, not a lot offering.
Lougheed Transit Corridor: see — adopted Jan 27, 2026; the City states the plan does not immediately change any property's zoning, so it creates no lot inventory by itself.

Hammond recreation proposals: the City put two Hammond projects to an assent vote — the Hammond Aquatics and Recreation Centre at 11509 207 Street / 20601 Westfield Avenue (Loan Authorization Bylaw No. 8123-2026) and the Hammond Multi-Use Community Park at 20818 Golf Lane, the current Maple Ridge Golf Course site (Bylaw No. 8124-2026); the outcome of the votes is not confirmed. Neither is a land sale.
: Presale projects inside the sub-area: none verified in the research (UNVERIFIED list).

blocks.text: Streets, schools and getting around Southwest Maple Ridge

items.t: The official planning frame is the Hammond Area Plan (OCP s. 10.5), covering Hammond in the southwest corner; the City's neighbourhoods page also lists Port Hammond and Port Haney in this part of the city.

The Hammond Area Plan describes its area: "The Hammond neighbourhood is located in the southwest corner of Maple Ridge. It is bounded on the west by the City of Pitt Meadows and the Katzie First Nation, and on the south by the Fraser River; to the north are Lougheed Highway and Dewdney Trunk Road commercial areas, and to the east is mainly single-family development."
Nearby areas: Pitt Meadows to the west across the municipal boundary, West Central and the Town Centre to the east, Port Haney at the sub-area's east edge, and the Fraser River along the south.

Main roads and transit: Lougheed Highway along the north side; Maple Meadows Station (20010 Dunn Ave) on the west side and Port Haney Station (22300 River Road) at the east edge, West Coast Express weekdays between Waterfront (downtown Vancouver) and Mission City; buses 743 and 744 loop through Hammond streets (207 Street, Lorne Avenue, Hammond), 701 runs along Dewdney Trunk Road, 791 along the north side, and the R3 Lougheed Hwy RapidBus runs on the Lougheed Highway corridor north of the area.

Catchments: address-based in SD42; the district locator was run for a Hammond sample address (20577 Lorne Avenue) and returned NO RESULT because the address falls in a gap between the locator's listed ranges for Lorne Avenue, so catchment schools for this sub-area are NOT confirmed — check any address in the SD42 School Locator.

Parks: Hammond Park, 20577 Lorne Avenue, has benches, a playground, a sport court, a tennis court and a pickleball court; Hammond Community Park is the site of the Larry Walker and Hammond Stadium ballfields, Hammond Hall and the Hammond Outdoor Pool; the Maple Ridge Golf Course is at 20818 Golf Lane in Hammond.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Southwest Maple Ridge

items.t: OCP — CONTESTED citation, flagged, never resolved: The Hammond Area Plan is OCP s. 10.5, adopted, with a Hammond Development Permit Area (heritage) applying to properties within the Hammond Area Plan.

Lougheed Transit Corridor — ADOPTED Jan 27, 2026: the Lougheed Transit Corridor Area Plan was adopted January 27, 2026 — Official Community Plan Amending Bylaw No. 7781-2021 was given third reading and adopted at the January 27, 2026 Council meeting, following the January 20, 2026 public hearing; the corridor runs from the City's western boundary to the Town Centre at 221 Street along Lougheed Highway and Dewdney Trunk Road, with growth directed around future Bus Rapid Transit stations at 203 Street, 207 Street, Laity Street and 216 Street. The City states the plan does not immediately change any property's zoning.

Escarpment rules: the Fraser River Escarpment policy area (City Policies 6.23 and 6.24) is bounded by 207 Street to the west, 124 Avenue to the north, 224 Street to the east and the escarpment crest along the south; all drainage from new construction must connect to the City storm drainage system, properties within 300 m of the crest require a geotechnical report attached to a Section 219 covenant before a building permit, and properties within 100 m of the crest require a detailed geotechnical report addressing potential seismic slope failure; in the policy area septic fields are to be avoided and new residences require sanitary sewers.

ALR rules — general framework, no ALR ground documented in this sub-area: where a parcel is in the ALR, subdivision within the ALR requires ALC approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s.6; Strata Property Act s.239; Agricultural Land Commission Act s.21(1)); ALC residence caps: principal ≤500 m², suite within principal only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha); BC Assessment farm class is three-tiered ($2,500 on 0.8–4 ha; $2,500 + 5% of value over 4 ha; $10,000 under 0.8 ha; applications by Oct 31) — a flat "$2,500+" line is an ERROR. No parcel in this sub-area is documented as ALR in the research, so these rules are carried as the framework to apply only if a parcel check shows ALR.

blocks.text: Good to know about Southwest Maple Ridge

items.t: Hammond began as Port Hammond Junction. The City records that the Hammond brothers, William and John, donated land to the CPR on the condition the first railway station in Maple Ridge be built in Hammond, and the junction served as a supply depot as the community grew around the station, yards and a cedar mill — the origin of the heritage stock and the Hammond Development Permit Area.

The school locator has a hole on Lorne Avenue. The SD42 locator returned no result at all for 20577 Lorne Avenue — the address falls between the locator's listed ranges — so a buyer can do everything right and still get no catchment answer from the tool; that gap is documented here rather than papered over with a nearest-school guess.

Two Hammond recreation projects went to an assent vote, outcome unconfirmed. The Hammond Aquatics and Recreation Centre (Bylaw No. 8123-2026) and Hammond Multi-Use Community Park on the golf course site (Bylaw No. 8124-2026) were put to residents; whether the borrowing passed is UNCONFIRMED — do not price land here on either facility being built.

No recreation centre or library branch sits in the southwest. The Maple Ridge Leisure Centre is at 11925 Haney Place in the Town Centre to the east, and Maple Ridge Public Library is at 130 – 22470 Dewdney Trunk Road — land here is bought for the Hammond / river / station position, with a drive for those facilities.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Southwest Maple Ridge than in June?
faq.a: In Southwest Maple Ridge, listings of houses fell from 63 in June to 41 in September (−34.9%); condos and townhomes fell from 11 in June to 8 in September (−27.3%).

faq.q: How big is Southwest Maple Ridge compared with the rest of Maple Ridge?
faq.a: In September 2026, Southwest Maple Ridge held 10.0% of the 410 houses listed in Maple Ridge and 2.8% of the 286 condos and townhomes listed in Maple Ridge.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Southwest Maple Ridge from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 30 houses and 7 condos and townhomes sold in Southwest Maple Ridge over those 4 months.

faq.q: Who can help me buy or sell in Southwest Maple Ridge?
faq.a: Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, works across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361 or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: How do I find out which school serves an address in Southwest Maple Ridge?
faq.a: School catchments are set by address, so use the school district's catchment locator with the exact address. Catchment lines change, so check before you write an offer.

faq.q: Is there bare land for sale in Hammond / Southwest Maple Ridge?
faq.a: No named bare-land subdivision, bare-land strata or presale lot offering was verified.

faq.q: How big does a lot have to be to subdivide or build?
faq.a: RS-1 minimums are 668.0 m² lot area, 18.0 m width and 27.0 m depth, with maximum lot coverage 40% under Zoning Bylaw No. 7600-2019 s. 605. Those are zone minimums, not a subdivision promise for a specific parcel.

faq.q: Can I put a suite or extra units on a lot here?
faq.a: One secondary suite per lot inside the house (maximum 40% of gross floor area, not in the floodplain), and eligible single-detached and duplex lots may have up to three, four or six units under the City's SSMUH bylaws.

faq.q: Can I have a rental suite on a floodplain lot?
faq.a: No — Zoning Bylaw s. 402.8(h) prohibits rental accommodation (suites) on floodplain properties, and no habitable floor space may sit below the 6.7 m flood construction level on affected lots.

faq.q: What does the escarpment mean for building?
faq.a: Lots within 300 m of the crest need a geotechnical report on a Section 219 covenant before a building permit; within 100 m, a detailed report on seismic slope failure; drainage must go to the City storm system, septic fields are to be avoided and new residences require sanitary sewers in the policy area.
